$comment: AKR frozen vocabulary spine. Machine-readable form of decisions D-001, D-002, D-004, D-005, D-010, D-012, D-013, D-016 and D-017 in docs/DECISIONS.md. Human-readable tables in docs/02-data-model.md are checked against this file by tools/check-design.py. This file is authoritative for names; the prose documents are authoritative for meaning.

value_types.enum: Bare identifier drawn from a fixed set.
value_types.commit: git: followed by exactly 40 lowercase hex digits (D-008).
value_types.ref: Reference in one of the four forms of D-009.
value_types.block: Named brace block, at most once per record.
value_types.T[]: Array of T, written [ a, b ] (D-012).

normative.means: States what ought to be true; binds future work.

empirical.means: States what was found to be true, at a stated point in history.

planning.means: States what is intended, in what order, and when it is done.

inquiry.means: States what is not yet known.

empirical.note: needs-review is not a state; staleness is derived (D-003).

common_slots.name: title
common_slots.doc: One-line human label; the heading used in every generated view.

common_slots.name: state
common_slots.doc: Lifecycle state, drawn from the kind's class lifecycle.

common_slots.name: scope
common_slots.doc: What this record governs or was observed about (D-010).

common_slots.name: topic
common_slots.doc: Opt-in exclusivity handle; two live normative records with the same topic and overlapping scope conflict (D-004b).

common_slots.name: retired_claims
common_slots.doc: Claim anchors present in the previous revision and dropped by this one (D-011).

common_slots.name: acknowledged
common_slots.doc: Marks a declared contradiction as knowingly tolerated (D-023).

common_slots.name: author
common_slots.doc: Who authored this revision. Free text; not an identity system.

canonical_slot_order: <relation slots, alphabetical; refs sorted by key, revision, anchor>
<source blocks, sorted by kind then path/url>

term.purpose: Fixes the project's meaning for a word that would otherwise drift.

requirement.purpose: States something the delivered system must do or must be.

policy.purpose: States a standing rule about how the project works, not about what it delivers.

constraint.purpose: States a limit the project must respect but did not choose.

decision.purpose: Records a choice made between alternatives, and what follows from it.

observation.purpose: Records what was found to be true of the system at a specific commit.

evidence.purpose: Records the outcome of a check that was actually run.
evidence.note: Evidence never declares what it verifies; verified_by runs from the verified thing to the evidence (D-016).

assessment.purpose: Records a judgement drawn from observations, distinct from the observations themselves.

papercut.purpose: Records a small friction hit while working: what was being done, what got in the way, and optionally a guess at the cause or fix (D-027).

content_slots.name: about
content_slots.doc: What the friction was with, when that is not this project: a tool name such as `akr`. Absent means this project's own code or setup. `akr papercut collate --about <subject>` gathers the sisters' papercuts aimed at one subject (D-033).

content_slots.name: collated
content_slots.doc: Source papercut keys this collation record absorbed from sister projects; written by `akr papercut collate`, the dedup set for the next run (D-030).

papercut.note: Filled automatically by `akr papercut` and knowledge.papercut: the agent lands in author, the date in created_at, observed_at defaults to HEAD. No watches, so a papercut never goes stale (D-027).

milestone.purpose: A named point at which a defined set of acceptance checks passes.

content_slots.name: note
content_slots.doc: Free-form operator commentary. Informational only; no validation consequence. Rendered by views for records in terminal states (D-026).

work.purpose: A unit of intended change. A work record designated plan_of_record is a plan (D-001).

content_slots.name: note
content_slots.doc: Free-form operator commentary. Informational only; no validation consequence. Rendered by views for records in terminal states (D-026).

track.purpose: Standing, non-terminating work that milestones do not contain.

content_slots.name: note
content_slots.doc: Free-form operator commentary. Informational only; no validation consequence. Rendered by views for records in terminal states (D-026).

question.purpose: An open matter that blocks or endangers a decision or a plan.

claim.head: identifier
claim.doc: An individually addressable assertion within a record; referenced as @key/2#anchor (D-011).

acceptance.doc: What 'done' means for this planning record (D-016).

check.head: identifier
check.doc: Satisfied when a referenced evidence record has result pass and an observed_at commit descended from the work item's last content change (D-016).

source.doc: Where this record's content came from. Migration provenance uses kind legacy (D-022). A citation into the immutable source library names document plus start_byte, end_byte, start_line and end_line, which are all-or-nothing (D-031); excerpt_hash lets akr check prove the range still holds the cited passage. A citation names a document and a byte range, never a chunk id, because chunk boundaries belong to a rebuildable index.

disposition.head: ref
disposition.doc: Required on a superseding planning record for every unfinished part_of child of the record it supersedes (D-017). into is required for carried_forward and completed_elsewhere, optional for still_required_separately, forbidden for intentionally_dropped.

supported_by.consequence: The source's standing rests on the target; a stale target flags the source at_risk.

depends_on.consequence: A completed planning target satisfies the dependency; other terminal targets invalidate it (V-019).

supersedes.consequence: Puts the target into superseded state; requires disposition of unfinished children for planning kinds (V-017).

contradicts.consequence: Must be dispositioned; always surfaced in context, never suppressed by ranking (D-023).

implements.consequence: Ties intended change to the normative record that motivates it.

resolves.consequence: A question in resolved state must be the target of at least one live resolves edge.

derived_from.consequence: Records provenance between records; carries staleness.

part_of.consequence: Defines the child set used by disposition (V-017) and by ref-scope overlap (D-010).

after.consequence: Defines milestone order; the graph must be acyclic (V-016).

blocks.consequence: A live blocker forces the target planning record into blocked state and is surfaced in context.

verified_by.consequence: Satisfies acceptance checks under the descendant-commit rule (D-016). Runs one way only.

plan_of_record.consequence: Designates the authoritative plan for the target; at most one live plan per target (V-018).

scope_terms.doc: Organisational scope. Two ref terms overlap if equal or connected by part_of.
Code scope. Two path terms overlap if their literal prefixes are prefix-comparable, ** matching any run of segments.

V-001.title: Every reference resolves to a declared key and existing revision

V-002.title: A key's namespace must be declared in project.akr

V-003.title: All revisions of one key live in one file

V-004.title: Claim and check anchors exist; retired anchors are reported distinctly

V-005.title: Relation and slot targets are kind-correct

V-006.title: References to invalid terminal records only via historical relations

V-007.title: The kind and state combination is legal for the kind's class

V-008.title: Required slots present; unknown slots rejected

V-010.title: Evidence carries result, method and observed_at

V-011.title: A resolved question carries a resolution and a live resolves edge

V-012.title: At most one live revision per key

V-013.title: No two live normative records share a topic with overlapping scope

V-015.title: depends_on, derived_from, part_of, implements and blocks graphs are acyclic

V-017.title: A superseding planning record disposes of every unfinished child

V-018.title: At most one live plan_of_record per milestone or track

V-019.title: A live record does not rely on an invalid terminal record

V-020.title: A completed milestone or work record has every acceptance check satisfied

V-021.title: An active decision cites a requirement, policy, constraint or evidence

V-023.title: A declared contradiction is resolved or acknowledged

V-024.title: A sealed revision matches its content hash in akr.lock

V-025.title: An evidence artifact is cited from a durable path

rule_id_ranges.V-101..V-149: Freshness, emission and context rules. docs/10-freshness-and-git.md, docs/11-projections.md, docs/09-context-assembly.md.
